composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Create a short ocher cylinder with a rectangular blue cutout. The cutout reveals a deep blue interior and one pale inner ledge, without any literal room furnishings. Keep the cylinder low and broad, with a slightly offset opening for balance. Use matte surfaces, one soft upper highlight, and a crisp contact shadow. Avoid marks, labels, or decorative grooves. Use minimal geometric object illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
